comments.author: @RemoteEarthJourneys
comments.text:
🌍 Watch another journey into how people really live around the world: 
👉Living in Christmas Island | How Life Works When Millions of Crabs Take Over https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1dxrsxVcLS8
👉Living in Tuvalu | How Life Works in a Country That Could Disappear  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XLfBG7wXwQ4
What struck me most about Indonesia is that the ocean isn’t just separating communities — in many places, it actually becomes part of the road.
If you’re from Indonesia, I’m curious: what’s one thing this video got right about everyday life where you live? And what’s something foreigners almost always misunderstand?
I’d especially love to hear from people living outside Java or on smaller islands. How different is transportation, shopping, or getting supplies where you are?

Tell us where you’re watching from too!
